claims.source_quote_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ يكون مِنْهُم رَافعا لمن
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن يكون «فَمِنْهُمْ» رافعاً (مرفوعاً) ارتباطًا بـ«مَنْ» — أي إمكان رفْع موضعه النحوي في التحليل.
claims.claim_en: It is possible that «فَمِنْهُمْ» is to be analyzed as raised (nominative) in relation to «مَنْ» — i.e. it may function as if lifted to a nominative position in the analysis.
claims.needs_review_reason: The phrase 'رافعا' indicates an atypical analysis (a prepositional phrase being 'raised'); the exact syntactic status (how 'raising' is implemented) needs verification against fuller commentary or examples.

claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون الجملة «مَنْ آمنَ…» جملةً اسميةً مكونةً من مبتدأ وخبر (أي تحليلها كـمبتدأٍ وخبرٍ).
claims.claim_en: The clause (e.g. «مَنْ آمَنَ…») may be analyzed as a nominal sentence consisting of a subject (mubtada') and predicate (khabar).
claims.needs_review_reason: The author lists this as one possible analysis among others; it requires contextual confirmation which reading the broader commentary would provide.

claims.claim_ar: الجملة «فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آمَنَ…» نعتٌ لـ «الرُّسُلِ» (أي الجملة في مقام نعت يحدِّث عن الرسل).
claims.claim_en: The clause «فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آمَنَ…» functions as a na‘t (attributive clause) modifying «الرسُل» (i.e. it qualifies/describes the messengers).
claims.needs_review_reason: Although stated clearly in the source, the exact syntactic attachment (which word it modifies and how this interacts with sentence-level parsing) should be cross-checked with full commentary context.

claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون الجملة مستأنفَةً — أي جملة مستقلة مستأنفة عن الجملة السابقة.
claims.claim_en: It is possible that the clause is a resumed (mustanfa') independent sentence (i.e. an independent sentence resumed after the preceding clause).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source lists this as an alternative; determining whether it is the preferred reading requires further context from the commentary.
